about: What a host that runs an agent for Kalmido does, and where the reference launcher does it (2.35.0, #1098). tests/launcher_parity_test.py checks that agent_launcher.sh AND agent_launcher.ps1 both carry every capability (a line '# kalmido-capability: <id>' where they do it or hand it to agent_run.py) and that agent_run.py has the code named in 'core'. A new capability of a hosted service goes here first; the test then fails until both launchers have it.

capabilities.what: Runtime settings from GET /api/v1/agent: model, auto-compact, fresh session, restart on change / Reset now / nightly, stop while paused
Prose between tool calls as steps (POST /api/v1/agent/progress): text blocks only, never tool input or output, secrets masked, at most one every 2 s, the final answer is no step, none for task events
The model of the stream's init event with PUT /api/v1/agent/status (model)
The run's permission mode and the host default (permission_mode, host_permission_mode)

Plan usage (PUT /api/v1/agent/quota) from the stream's rate_limit_event or a status line file, with measured_at; stale values are unknown; every window passes through; optional own limit pauses new runs
The quote of the message a person answers goes into the prompt; reply_to when one answer covers several messages
Status working / idle / error per run, typing dots while a chat run lasts
An answer ending in an ```approval block becomes an approval card (approval: {title, what}); older servers: Yes / No buttons; the answer comes back as chat_choice with approval; silence is no
Older servers: a feature the server does not know (404 / 400) is switched off once, the rest keeps working
